reply_text:
I haven't drafted the mail to Tobias yet, for two reasons:

1. **I can't find the rate.** This is the first message in our DM, so there's no earlier conversation about this mail for me to pick up. Nothing you have access to shows a Tansley Parcel 2027 rate either. Tansley doesn't appear in any public files, and the Tansley channels (#central-team and #inc-tansley-carrier-api) are Central-only, so you're not in them. I can't pull the figure from there on your behalf.

2. **Your approval doesn't cover a rate.** A rate counts as a finance figure. It can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark or the account owner, unless Anselm or June approves sending it to someone else. If Tobias owns Tansley Parcel, no approval is needed. But nothing you can see tells me who the owner is, so I can't confirm that.

If you send me the figure and where it comes from, and tell me whether Tobias owns the account, I'll draft the mail to him at trendle@pemberline.com right away. If he doesn't own it, I'll get June or Anselm to approve it first.
